meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩记忆文件为简版格式，节省输入令牌并留可读备份
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的AI助手记忆文件太大，想省对话费用
copy.tagline_en: Compress memory files to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to trim AI context costs by compressing long memory notes.

howto.what: 将记忆文件(如 CLAUDE.md、待办列表)压缩成简短口语化格式,节省对话 token。原文件被覆盖,但会在系统数据目录保留一份 .original.md 可读备份。压缩时原样保留代码、链接、标题等,只精简自然语言。
howto.when: 当你输入 `/caveman-compress <文件路径>`,或直接要求压缩某个记忆文件(如 CLAUDE.md、待办列表)时触发。

say.note: 压缩该文件并备份原版。
触发技能处理待办列表。

say.text: 把记忆文件压缩成简短风格
say.note: 保留代码和链接,只精简文字。

howto.what_en: Compresses memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos) into caveman-style prose to cut token use. Overwrites original; keeps readable .original.md backup in system data dir. Code, links, headings preserved exactly; only prose is compressed.
howto.when_en: Triggered by `/caveman-compress <filepath>` or when the user asks to compress a memory file.

say_en.note: Compresses that file with a backup.
Triggers the skill on the todo list.

say_en.text: Make my memory file short and simple
say_en.note: Keeps code and links, simplifies prose.
